title: Meta commits up to $14.2B for CoreWeave AI cloud

sources.quote: Subject to any termination described below and satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, Meta has initially committed to pay the Company up to approximately $14.2 billion through December 14, 2031 under the Order Form, with the option to materially expand its commitment through 2032 for additional cloud computing capacity under the Order Form.

explain: Meta agreed to pay CoreWeave up to about $14.2 billion through December 2031 to rent AI computing capacity, with an option to buy more. It made Meta one of CoreWeave's largest customers alongside Microsoft and OpenAI.
